images.caption: Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors) is a 17th century palace located in the Lahore fort complex. The palace was built during the reign of Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, with marble walls intricately decorated with inlaid convex mirror mosaic, precious stone pietra dura and stucco tracery, as well as some Kangra style frescoes depicting Hindu dieties added later during Sikh rule.
images.alt: Sheesh Mahal (Palace of Mirrors) is a 17th century palace located in the Lahore fort complex. The palace was built during the reign of Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, with marble walls intricately decorated with inlaid convex mirror mosaic, precious stone pietra dura and stucco tracery, as well as some Kangra style frescoes depicting Hindu dieties added later during Sikh rule.

images.filename: Bibi Ka Maqbara in the morning hours, Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India 37.jpg
images.caption: The Bibi Ka Maqbara is a tomb located in the city of Aurangabad now known as Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in Maharashtra, India. It was commissioned in 1660 by the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb's son, Prince Azam Shah, in the memory of his mother Dilras Banu Begum (posthumously known as Rabia-ul-Durrani). The monuments bears a striking resemblance to the Taj Mahal, the mausoleum of Aurangzeb's mother, Mumtaz Mahal.
images.alt: The Bibi Ka Maqbara is a tomb located in the city of Aurangabad now known as Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in Maharashtra, India.
